description: Servicios de Urgencias y Ambulancias is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Prestador con servicios de urgencias y/o de servicio de transporte asistencial básico y medicalizado. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Salud - SDS. Its tags are SERVICIOS DE SALUD, Salud Bogotá, Salud y Protección Social, Secretaria de Salud, salud. It offers 14 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-07-23 as the last update. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
